The '''Q'mara system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

==Position in Galaxy==
The Q'mara system lies on the [[Velga Route]] in the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]], which resides in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].
